sections.st: Retail Packaging for FMCG Products Manufacturer India — Custom Inserts, Bulk from Vapi
leads: Trizen Packaging manufactures retail packaging for FMCG products from our ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Vapi, Gujarat — custom food-grade thermoformed retail packaging inserts for large FMCG brand product ranges. FMCG packaging manufacturer from Vapi Daman for branded shelf display inserts, promotional display trays, and custom thermoformed inserts for established FMCG companies.

FMCG retail packaging inserts are the interface between the branded product and the retail shelf consumer. The thermoformed insert holds the branded product at the correct shelf-facing orientation, communicates brand identity through material (food-grade APET crystal-clear for product visibility, food-grade PP for tray-format products), and provides physical protection during distribution.

sections.st: Three Problems Retail Packaging for FMCG Products Buyers Face

strips.title: Retail Shelf Presence — FMCG Product Not in Brand-Correct Orientation
strips.desc: Problem: FMCG retail packaging inserts that do not hold the branded product in the correct shelf-facing orientation hide the brand label. Solution: Insert geometry designed to hold the product in the correct shelf-facing orientation — brand label forward, product information visible.

strips.title: Food-Grade Gap in FMCG Retail Packaging Supply Chain
strips.desc: Problem: Large FMCG brands require food-grade material documentation for all retail packaging components. Solution: Food-grade PP and APET with IS/EU food contact material certification per production batch.

strips.title: FMCG Scale OEM Consistency — Large Brand Retail Programme Volumes
strips.desc: Problem: FMCG retail packaging programmes require thousands of units per run with consistent specification. Solution: Bulk FMCG packaging manufacturer Vapi — food-grade CoA and ISO 9001:2015 per run.
